provider: Yahoo Finance public chart endpoint v8 (query1.finance.yahoo.com), interval 1d

fields.open, high, low, close: split-adjusted prices in USD, rounded to 6 decimals
fields.adj_close: split- and dividend-adjusted close as Yahoo reported it on fetchedAt, rounded to 6 decimals

adjustment: Both backtest paths scale open, high, low and close by adj_close/close (total-return bars).
delay: End-of-day history only; the newest bar is from 2024-12-31. No live or intraday data.
license: Yahoo Finance data is for personal, non-commercial use and must not be redistributed. This copy is a test fixture in a private repository. Do not publish it, copy it to report pages or ship it in a build.
